policy: Every price in this file is a dated snapshot copied from the cited source page. Nothing here is estimated or averaged silently. The primary snapshot is used for all calculations and is displayed with its source timestamp.

constants.karat_note: Fineness computed as karat / 24. 14K = 14/24 = 0.58333 (583.3 parts per thousand). Some countries stamp 585; the US statutory tolerance is in 15 U.S.C. 295 (see sources).

snapshots.quote: Spot Gold Price: USD 3,995.88 / Ounce | Spot Silver Price: USD 53.92 / Ounce Oct 23rd, 2026 at 07:41 NY Time
snapshots.note: Read live 2026-10-23T23:43Z. 0.655% below the primary snapshot ($4,022.22/oz, captured the same morning). Five independent feeds read the same evening cluster within 0.025%: Kitco $3,994.90 (2026-10-23 19:43 NY), BullionVault $3,995.74 (23 Oct 2026 17:00 GMT-4), GoldPrice.org $3,995.88, World Gold Council $3,995.47 (data as of 22 October 2026). build_site.py selects the newest live-check snapshot, so this is the reading the calculator labels as the live reference.

cross_check.note: The two independent snapshots read on 2026-10-23 differ by 0.055%, which is consistent with normal intraday movement between the two timestamps (and within 0.06% of Dataset C's simultaneous Kitco $4,022.70/oz & BullionVault $4,024.23/oz quotes). Calculations use the primary (GoldPrice.org) snapshot; the World Gold Council figure is shown next to it so the reader can see the spread.
cross_check.benchmark_note: The LBMA Gold Price is the global benchmark, set twice daily by ICE Benchmark Administration. LBMA states (re-verified live 2026-10-23) that real-time and historical benchmark data require an IBA licence and that the public tables have moved behind the MyLBMA portal, so no LBMA figure is reproduced here. Source: https://www.lbma.org.uk/prices-and-data/lbma-precious-metal-prices

live_check_note: A third, explicitly labelled live-check reading is kept beside the two calculation snapshots. It is never consumed by the calculator: the arithmetic on every page stays pinned to the dated primary snapshot so the printed results can be reproduced.
